    sep = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] == 2)
    bg = max((v for v in set(v for r, row in enumerate(grid) if r != sep for v in row)),
             key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for r, row in enumerate(grid) if r != sep))
    coords = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) if r != sep for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != bg]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in coords); r1 = max(r for r, c in coords)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in coords); c1 = max(c for r, c in coords)
    patch = [row[c0:c1+1] for row in grid[r0:r1+1]]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(r0, r1+1):
        for c in range(c0, c1+1):
            out[r][c] = bg
    if r0 > sep:
        nr0, nr1 = sep + 1, sep + (r1-r0+1)
        marker = nr1 + 1
    else:
        nr1, nr0 = sep - 1, sep - (r1-r0+1)
        marker = nr0 - 1
    for i, row in enumerate(patch):
        out[nr0+i][c0:c1+1] = row[:]
    if 0 <= marker < h:
